mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate signals a robust demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of instances despite strong GDP growth, or GDP growth rate fails to exceed 2% YoY in any quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the federal funds rate below 0.5% signals an aggressive monetary easing, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in payroll employment and a decline in unemployment rate signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances despite strong labor market, or labor market indicators fail to show a joint increase in any quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in industrial production above 2% MoM signals a strong supply environment, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1.5-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in strong supply periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 500k units signals a weak demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 50% of instances despite weak demand, or housing starts fail to decline below 500k units in any quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in federal funds rate and a decline in GDP growth rate signals a monetary tightening cycle, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 40% of instances despite monetary tightening, or monetary indicators fail to show a joint increase in any quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment rate above 10% signals a weak labor market, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in weak labor market periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in retail sales and a decline in consumer price index signals a strong demand environment with low inflation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of instances despite strong demand and low inflation, or demand and inflation indicators fail to show a joint increase in any quarter.
